title: load_catalogs + seed_fixture duplicated between app/main.odin and harness/catalogs.odin; the app inlines the fixture positions while the harness names them — silent divergence is undetectable because the app is never verified against the goldens
detail: Fixture positions drive T1 hashes, the T2 golden pixels, and demo intents. Only the harness is golden-verified; the app renders from its own copy, so app/harness fixture drift would be invisible to every gate.
recommended_fix: Move fixture + catalog IO into a shared package both binaries import (the reference tree's app/run/catalogs.odin pattern), or at least share the FIXTURE_* constants with the app.

title: App discards the pipe_tier_index error for 'standard' while catalogs_load enforces residential/router_basic but not the tier — a renamed/removed 'standard' tier silently draws at tier index 0
detail: Catalog validation's fail-fast contract (§7.1, never silent) covers node types but not the 'standard' tier the app draws by default; the app's underscore-discard diverges from the harness's fail-loud handling of the same lookup.
recommended_fix: Add a "standard" required-tier check in catalogs_load (mirroring the residential/router_basic checks), and/or make the app abort when pipe_tier_index misses.

title: Lens-guard #7's documented Godot prototype does not exist at the ref path — it is the project's own evolved Odin tree; checked 1.2 against what is actually there and found no wholesale copy
location: /Users/moses/code/packet-plumber-prototype-ref (README.md, core/topology.odin, app/render/view.odin) vs worktree core/topology.odin + app/render/view.odin
evidence: Ref README.md: "The proven-fun Godot prototype is preserved at the `prototype-fun-gate` tag (removed from main in the Odin pivot, ruled 2026-08-08)" — no `prototype-fun-gate` tag exists in the clone (git tag -l: empty) and zero .gd files exist in the tree or history (git log --all --diff-filter=A -- '*.gd': empty). Comparing 1.2 against the Odin tree actually present: ref core/topology.odin:36-47 carries "node_by_id: map[u32]u32 ... pipe_by_id: map[u32]u32" + throughput/ports/weights/triage fields that 1.2's Topology (core/topology.odin:18-33) omits; ref span_between (core/topology.odin:89-97) uses "dx := i64(abs(a[0] - b[0]))" while 1.2 (core/topology.odin:75-80) squares without abs; 1.2 view.odin's View/Drag_State drop the ref's font/Selection/left/placing members. The shared isqrt/span_between/dist2/camera-fit math is the architecture's pinned §6.1/§9.1 metric, not prototype code.
detail: The from-scratch guard as documented (line-for-line GDScript port check) cannot be executed: no Godot source is available at the canonical ref path. Against the Odin tree present, 1.2 is a trimmed, rewritten subset of the project's own canon — no wholesale copy found.
recommended_fix: Restore the actual Godot prototype (prototype-fun-gate) at the documented ref path for future rounds, or amend the shared brief to point at the Odin reference tree the guard was actually checked against.
